outcome: The Save & share card is now compact and internally consistent
owner_impact: The top-right Save & share card now uses the short subtitle “Save, copy and share”. Its visible Save Revision, Save as new and Share actions are consolidated into one equal-size action bar that stays on one row when the card is wide enough and wraps evenly when needed. Collection movement remains where it already belongs: the Organize flow. Open save/share forms remain underneath only when used. Mobile retains 44px touch targets and a compact two-column action layout.

next.text: This direct-use #273 refinement is complete. Review the live Save & share card visually; #273 remains a dormant/living UI/UX domain and further refinement should continue from what you actually see and use.

technical_evidence: Save Revision, Save as new and Share are relocated into one experiment-management-actions grid; collection movement stays in the existing Organize dialog.
The Save & share subtitle is shortened from “Persistence, copies and collaboration” to “Save, copy and share”.
The action bar uses equal-width auto-fit columns with fixed 44px rows, so visible peer buttons remain the same size and stay on one row where space allows.
Share still opens the original read-only sharing form; save/copy/share semantics are unchanged.
Responsive production smoke verifies the shortened subtitle and action-bar presence.
No surrounding Control Panel structure, scientific/runtime, persistence, revision/autosave, sharing, authorization, Showcase or capability-request semantics changed.
The repair removes the incorrect dependency on the collection-organizer Move button, preventing experiment-management initialization failure.
